description: Grounding with Bing Search connection for the PMO Foundry project. infra/scripts/create-bing-connection.ps1 creates or updates this project connection. The subscription, resource group, and Foundry project come from infra/config/pmo-deployment.json and api/config/portfolio-agent.json. The Bing account must already exist in the resource group. The agent definitions reference the connection by name.
